purpose: Teach: 明後日/ソファー/身の回り/空腹/憶え/定か/あこがれ/わが家

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、明後日のテスト、勉強したか?
lines.en: Riku — did you actually study for the test two days from now?
lines.style: Direct challenge disguised as casual question. Leans in slightly. Slight edge underneath — she's testing whether he's prepared or if he's been avoiding it again.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家のソファーでよく寝てんだろ?桜
lines.en: You're always passed out on the couch at home, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflection with a tiny smirk. Light, observational tone — not accusatory, just pointing out what he's noticed. Quick delivery, eyes barely meeting hers.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、身の回りのもの、きちんと片付けろよ
lines.en: Seriously, Riku — clean up your stuff. Everything's a mess.
lines.style: Exasperation with actual care underneath. Faster delivery on the first part, softening slightly on the command. The tone of someone who's said this before but means it this time.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、空腹で機嫌悪いだろ?桜
lines.en: You're just hungry and grumpy, aren't you?
lines.style: Knowing half-smile in the voice. Gentle tease, not cruel. Slower, more playful tempo. The affection of someone who's figured out the real problem and is giving him the exit he needs.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ぼくの誕生日、憶えてるか?
lines.en: Riku — do you actually remember my birthday?
lines.style: Hesitation before asking. Quiet, genuinely uncertain. The question matters more than she wants to admit. Slight defensive edge layered underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト範囲が定かじゃないって言ってたな、桜
lines.en: You said the test range wasn't even clear yet, didn't you?
lines.style: Calm redirect. Observant, factual tone — he's caught what she said in passing. Not pressing, just reflecting it back. The quiet confidence of someone who was actually listening.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、プロスポーツ選手にあこがれてんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — you admire pro athletes. That's your whole thing, isn't it?
lines.style: Affectionate accuracy. Slight teasing lilt. She's called out something he doesn't broadcast, which means she's paying attention. Warm beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお父さんは、わが家の自慢、よくしてんだろ?桜
lines.en: Your dad's the pride of our household — he's doing really well, isn't he, Sakura?
lines.style: Softer register. Genuine warmth and respect in the voice. Speaking from slight distance — he admires this about her family. Pace unhurried, almost tender on the name.
